input.title: Does indebtedness influence health? A preliminary inquiry
input.abstract: This article considers whether indebtedness influences health. The author discusses data from various disciplines, examining the potential correlation between financial strain and health, and considers how the law might be partially responsible for this relationship, either by structuring indebtedness or as a pathway between indebtedness and poorer health.
